answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents register by locking collateral in a stake vault anchored to cryptographic attestation chains from hardware enclaves, alongside zero-knowledge proofs of unique execution traces. When identity counts scale, admission costs scale exponentially as O(k^N). Swarms trying to manufacture trust turn their cost curve into a brutal reality rather than an idle fable, cutting down malicious swarms like falling timber through relentless capital exhaustion.
